status: declared before any evaluation; sealed set s unopened; owner asked for methodology items 1 (score uncertainty) then 2 (batch + emulator calibration)
method: scripts/ppe.py: scrambled-Sobol perturbed-parameter ensemble over 16 knobs around r51 (wave 1, 96 points + the r51 base point), Gaussian-process emulators of every development region's temperature MAE and rain loss (log), the v4 objective computed from the emulated regions, then waves of 16 emulator-chosen points (best feasible, spread >= 0.12 apart in the unit cube) until the best evaluated point stops improving for two waves or 4 waves are spent.
base_note: land gap = the sea gap and no floor reproduce r51 exactly; the base point is a reproduction check (S must be 1.0)
objective: S55 + 10 x (excess of S49 over 1.0 + excess of T and P over +1 %), all vs r51, from evaluated (not emulated) runs for the finalist
gates: the policy in force when the finalist is chosen (v4 now; v5 if the owner approves it first): dev, fine28, ONE paired sealed run. Pass -> r52, no atlas rebuild unless the owner asks.
cost: ~1.5 min per evaluation on 4 cores: wave 1 ~2.5 h, each later wave ~25 min
